context_facts.statement: The build recipe runs CMake, builds cmark_static, and links cmark_fuzzer against build/src/libcmark.a.
Inputs shorter than sizeof(fuzz_config) return without parsing. For longer inputs, the two packed int fields supply options and width; the remaining bytes supply Markdown.
The harness masks parser options to SOURCEPOS, HARDBREAKS, UNSAFE, NOBREAKS, NORMALIZE, VALIDATE_UTF8, and SMART; the top two bits of the original options field select one of four parsing modes.

Modes 0, 1, and 2 respectively parse the Markdown buffer directly, parse a memory-backed file when the Markdown is nonempty, and feed chunks of at most 20 bytes to a parser before finishing it. Mode 3 calls markdown_to_html and frees its result.

When a parse mode returns a nonnull document, the harness invokes the CommonMark, HTML, LaTeX, man, and XML renderers, frees their returned strings, then frees the document. The LaTeX and man calls receive the input-derived width.

In both supplied versions, LaTeX rendering permits text wrapping only when width is positive and NOBREAKS is clear. A softbreak becomes a hard break with HARDBREAKS, a newline when width is zero and NOBREAKS is clear, or a space otherwise.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness passes its masked options and input-derived width to the LaTeX renderer.

context_facts.statement: In both supplied versions, man rendering uses the same width and option conditions for wrapping and softbreaks: HARDBREAKS produces a hard break; otherwise width zero with NOBREAKS clear produces a newline, and the remaining cases produce a space.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness invokes man rendering with the masked options and input-derived width.

context_facts.statement: The supplied LaTeX and man renderers each have distinct handling for URL links and images, while both omit HTML block and HTML inline nodes. evidence.dependency_reason: The harness invokes both renderers for a nonnull parsed document.
